## Compensation

How compensation discussions are best handled.

::: {.d-flex .flex-wrap .gap-3 .mt-3 .mb-4}
<button
  class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary"
  type="button"
  data-details-action="expand"
>
  Expand all
</button>
<button
  class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary"
  type="button"
  data-details-action="collapse"
>
  Collapse all
</button>
:::

<details>
<summary>Is there a fixed compensation expectation?</summary>
<p>
It is usually more useful to discuss compensation in relation to scope,
seniority, location assumptions, and whether the role leans more toward
research depth, product delivery, or leadership.
</p>
</details>

<details>
<summary>What helps make compensation talks efficient?</summary>
<p>
A sensible range, hiring level, and any location constraints are ideal to
share early. That makes it easier to decide quickly whether a process is worth
both sides' time.
</p>
</details>

Interview style, practicalities, and next-step expectations.

<details>
<summary>What interview formats work best?</summary>
<p>
Strong processes usually combine one practical discussion about problem solving
with one conversation on stakeholder judgment or project delivery, rather than
relying on generic puzzle rounds.
</p>
</details>

<details>
<summary>What happens after an initial recruiter conversation?</summary>
<p>
If the fit looks promising, the fastest next step is usually a clear role
brief, hiring level, and process outline so Andrea can decide quickly whether
to continue.
</p>
</details>
:::

<script
  src="https://assets.calendly.com/assets/external/widget.js"
  type="text/javascript"
  async
></script>
<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const calendlyBaseUrl = "https://calendly.com";

    document.querySelectorAll(".recruiter-calendly-trigger").forEach(
      (trigger) => {
        trigger.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
          const path = trigger.dataset.calendlyPath;
          const url = path ? `${calendlyBaseUrl}/${path}` : undefined;

          if (!url) {
            return;
          }

          if (window.Calendly) {
            event.preventDefault();
            window.Calendly.initPopupWidget({ url });
            return;
          }

          window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener");
        });
      },
    );

    document.querySelectorAll("[data-details-action]").forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        const tabPane = button.closest(".tab-pane");
        const shouldOpen = button.dataset.detailsAction === "expand";

        event.preventDefault();

        if (!tabPane) {
          return;
        }

        tabPane.querySelectorAll("details").forEach((detail) => {
          detail.open = shouldOpen;
        });
      });
    });
  });
</script>
